children: Let’s begin with Tata Steel’s proposed ₹32,266 crore acquisition of a 52.38% stake in APL Apollo Tubes. The complex deal has raised concerns over its valuation, ownership structure and contract manufacturing arrangements. It will require regulatory and shareholder approvals.
Jio to remove daily data usage limit cap on select plans from Nov 24

Next, Reliance Jio is removing the 2.5 GB daily data cap on its ₹399 and ₹3,999 plans from November 24. The move comes under its Happy New Year offer. Jio is also introducing ₹15 and ₹25 add-on plans with one- and two-day validity, respectively.
US blacklists Megaspeed, targeting firm central to Nvidia crisis

Turning to global technology news, the US has blacklisted Singapore-based Megaspeed International, restricting its access to advanced AI chips without a government licence. The move follows concerns over the diversion of advanced technology to unauthorised users. Six other entities across Singapore, Thailand and Malaysia have also been added to the list.
Google Cloud India denies mass layoffs, confirms 30 role cuts

Finally, Google Cloud India has denied reports of mass layoffs, clarifying that only around 30 roles were eliminated last week. The company said the cuts were part of a small organisational restructuring and reprioritisation of work.
